scope: Independent scientific, numerical, protocol and capture-implementation review of the exact frozen source. This is not evidence of empirical model performance.
verified_findings: Independent product quadrature confirms the Beta(1,1) prior posterior B=(C+1)/(J+2), with initial pairs independent of source probabilities.
Literal count, withheld-label exclusion, token-pooling equivalence, all-query gradient finite differences and conditional natural-label gradient expectation checks pass.
Fixed 2x2 conditions use matched inputs, initialization and batches within each of four independent replicate bundles; B-target supervision is explicitly diagnostic.
Primary, rare-row, source-risk and conditional Monte Carlo metrics, per-example paired differences and architecture-specific screening medians follow the frozen design.
Source-manifest and member hashes, archive allowlists, source/input/output gates, incomplete-run refusal, artifact identities and paired-array identity checks pass.
Injected deterministic nonfinite candidate states are preserved with prior and candidate parameters, gradients, moments, loss and step before abort.
Absent-triple score stabilization and corrected training-symbol accounting are included in the frozen source.
limits: No experimental sampling or actual optimizer fitting was performed during this review. Numerical fixtures and mocked failure paths are not empirical results.
Actual Space source-upload roundtrip remains a separate required receipt after this review; synthetic local fixture receipts are unit tests only.
The supplied-triple small readout is not an end-to-end Transformer and gives no learning lower bound, asymptotic-rate theorem, robust-training result or novelty claim.
Four replicates and descriptive thresholds do not provide strong general training-effect inference.
Process or machine death cannot guarantee execution of finally handlers; committed JSONL records distinguish completed steps from potentially partial later array writes.
